textbookBox.concept: The mean is the sum of all the values divided by the number of values, and the median is the middle value when the data is sorted.

beats.en: The mean is the sum of all the values divided by the number of values, and the median is the middle value when the data is sorted.
beats.speakEn: The mean is the sum of all the values divided by the number of values, and the median is the middle value when the data is sorted.

beats.en: For 3 and 7 the mean is 5, and for 8 and 9 the mean is 8.5, which is always halfway between two numbers.

textbookBox.concept: On a dot plot the mean is the balance point: the total distance of values below the mean equals the total distance above it.

beats.en: On a dot plot the mean is the balance point: the total distance of values below the mean equals the total distance above it.
beats.speakEn: On a dot plot the mean is the balance point: the total distance of values below the mean equals the total distance above it.

beats.en: For 10, 10, 11 and 17 the mean is 12, and the distances below (2 + 2 + 1) equal the distance above (5).
